about: In the depths of the Underworld, Carly and the Reaperman visit the worlds of the spirits that inhabit this place. Master platforming, solve puzzles and build your way to victory. This asymmetrical game let's the giant Reaperman pick up platforms, and the little girl Carly jumps on top of the platforms that the Reaperman places. You can either control both characters by yourself, or grab a friend to play with - either way, escaping the Underworld is not an easy task!
- Follow the story of Carly and the Reaperman as they take on the Underworld
PlayStation®VR and PlayStation®Camera is required to play this product
